item.title: [SG] [30PCS FREE 1PC] TheFaceShop Real Nature Face Mask - MeowCat
item.description:
All our products are 100% authentic and directly imported from our brand owner in Korea.

**BUY 30PCS FREE 1PCS MASK**

Description
- These masks are saturated with different plant extracts to deliver intense moisture and nutrition.
- The Face Shop Real Nature Face Mask is created by fresh natural plants, the different types of natural plants mildly take care of healthy skin everyday. 
- The masks keep skin moisturized for long time with its excellent adherence.
- These masks are saturated with different plant extracts to deliver intense moisture and nutrition.

How to use
1. Adjust skin texture with toner after cleansing.
2. Spread the mask sheet over the face, avoiding the eye and lip areas.
3. Leave on for 10-15 minutes. Lightly pat remaining essence to aid absorption.

Aloe: 
The soothing, hydrating sheet mask with aloe extract is gentle on sensitive skin.

Avocado: 
This moisturizing and nourishing sheet mask with avocado extract hydrates and nourishes skin.

Bamboo: 
The revitalizing, hydrating sheet mask with bamboo extract moisturizes skin to revitalize your complexion.

Blueberry: 
The sheet mask with blueberry extract creates a firming moisture barrier to revitalize and energize skin.

Calendula: 
The soothing, moisturizing sheet mask with calendula extract calms skin, leaving it feeling comfortable.

Cucumber: 
The balancing sheet mask with cucumber extract restores moisture to skins that are in need of hydration.

Green Tea: 
The hydrating, clarifying sheet mask with green tea extract infuses skin with moisture to clarify your complexion.

Kelp: 
The purifying sheet mask with kelp extract tones tired skin chapped and stressed by the elements, leaving it smooth and clear.

Lemon: 
The brightening sheet mask with lemon extract brightens dull skin to create a radiant look.

Lingzhi: 
The radiance firming sheet mask with lingzhi mushroom stem extract nourishes skin and promotes skin elasticity.

Lotus: 
The hydrating, purifying sheet mask with lotus flower infuses skin with moisture, leaving it feeling clean.

Mung Bean: 
The pore-tightening sheet mask with mung bean extract temporarily tightens pores to create a smoother complexion.

Olive: 
The ultra-moisturising sheet mask with olive extract deeply hydrates dry, rough skin.

Pomegranate: 
The firming and revitalising sheet mask with pomegranate extract restore skin's elasticity and vitality.

Potato: 
This soothing sheet mask with potato extract provides a cooling sensation to relive skin that looks tired due to exposure to strong sunlight.

Red Ginseng: 
The firming sheet mask with red ginseng extract deeply nourishes skin to make it firmer.

Rice: 
The brightening sheet mask with rice extract softens and brighten rough, darkened skin.

Shea Butter: 
The nourishing and firming sheet mask with shea butter extract deeply nourishes dry skin to improve its elasticity.

Tea Tree: 
The refreshing and soothing sheet mask with tea tree extract helps smooth skin that is shiny due to excess oil
